lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: The lobby finally loaded.

lines.speaker: Andres
lines.text: My camera is floating behind the truck.

lines.speaker: Didi
lines.text: Everyone grab a cart by the entrance.

lines.speaker: Rika
lines.text: Mine has one wheel and no brakes.

lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: Save the yellow cart for the steep hill.

lines.speaker: Andres
lines.text: I see two zombies by the fountain.

lines.speaker: Didi
lines.text: The bridge is blocked by a delivery van.

lines.speaker: Rika
lines.text: I found another ramp behind the garage.

lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: The back wheel is stuck in the fence.

lines.speaker: Didi
lines.text: Take the blue route around the corner.

lines.speaker: Andres
lines.text: I will grab the cart on the other side.

lines.speaker: Rika
lines.text: The vending machine is coming with us.

lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: Leave the door open for the last cart.

lines.speaker: Andres
lines.text: I will restart my recording at the gate.

lines.speaker: Didi
lines.text: Wait for the gate to go all the way up.

lines.speaker: Rika
lines.text: The cart is balanced on the railing.

lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: It is moving and nobody is pushing it.

lines.speaker: Didi
lines.text: It tipped straight into the fountain.

lines.speaker: Andres
lines.text: My recording is back after the gate.

lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: Bring it over to the playground slide.

lines.speaker: Didi
lines.text: There is a zombie in the shopping cart.

lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: Throw the zombie down the slide!

lines.speaker: Rika
lines.text: Wait, the cart is sliding too!

lines.speaker: Andres
lines.text: The whole cart landed on the roof.

lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: There goes our getaway vehicle.

lines.speaker: Didi
lines.text: I caught the landing from the playground.

lines.speaker: Rika
lines.text: That was a very expensive shortcut.

lines.speaker: Andres
lines.text: We should race four carts down the slide.

lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: The green one is fast but it rolls over.

lines.speaker: Didi
lines.text: Someone left the ramp beside the truck.

lines.speaker: Rika
lines.text: Let us park everything under the bridge.

lines.speaker: Cindy
lines.text: I can still see the cart on the roof.

lines.speaker: Andres
lines.text: That is the end of my recording.
